title: Multi-Profile Derivative Rendering: Portrait/Token/Paper-Doll/Top-Down/Isometric/Sprite/Stance
objective: Implement deterministic renderer/output-profile derivatives from the same semantic appearance workspace, including portrait/dialogue/reference/token/paper-doll/top-down/isometric/thumbnail/sprite/stance outputs, without creating independent identity, canonical state, or renderer-specific authority.

scope.purpose: Project one semantic MCCS appearance workspace into multiple deterministic derivative presentation profiles/adapters rather than separate identity systems.
scope.completion_gate: Representative humanoid and nonhumanoid semantic appearance workspaces can produce deterministic multi-profile derivative plans with explicit unsupported/loss states and stable shared identity/provenance references, without canonical/live-state mutation or paid/cloud dependency.

selection_boundaries: MCCS-01, MCCS-03, MCCS-05, MCCS-06, MCCS-09 and MCCS-11 are completed_verified foundations and are not reopened.
Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-11-triggered rotation or interstitial override; reduced MCCS strict order therefore selects MCCS-13.
Renderer/output differences are profiles/adapters over one semantic appearance workspace and may not create independent Character/NPC/Creature/Species/Form/Asset identity truth.

CAPP/PPIA retain renderer-neutral appearance authority; PAPT/PCA retain generic image/sprite/character-asset production primitives and ARI/PCA retain generic identity/provenance/version/review infrastructure.
Unsupported renderer capabilities or lossy projections remain explicit rather than silently rewriting semantic appearance.
Animation/Scene/Combat/Dialogue and other runtime owners retain live pose/action/placement/state authority.
MCCS-13 is selected_not_started only; no implementation branch or authority exists until a later owner Continue.
ui-implementation and player-species remain independently governed and must be preserved exactly from fresh CURRENT.
next_action: MCCS-13 is closed. Fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH schema 1.0.4 contains no MCCS-13-triggered rotation or interstitial override, so reduced MCCS strict order selects MCCS-16 — Style Packs, Templates, Renderer Profiles & Visual Variant Recipes — as selected_not_started.
